title: 第21章 你来打我啊第22章 疗伤和战利品清点
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
顾平拖着伤痕累累的身体，踉跄着跪倒在苏媚与楚玉身旁。
两人衣衫早已被血与汗浸透，破碎的布料下露出雪白的肌肤，凌乱中透着一丝脆弱的美感。
“得罪了。”
顾平嗓音沙哑，目光清明如古井。
他先扶起楚玉，掌心贴在她后背的伤口上，阴阳二气流转，温和的灵力渗入她体内。
楚玉闷哼一声，身子不自觉地轻颤，因失血而苍白的脸颊泛起一抹红晕。
她半阖着眼，睫毛微湿，呼吸随着顾平掌心的温度逐渐急促。
“顾道友……”
她低喃，指尖无意识地攥紧他的衣襟，身子却软软地朝他怀里靠去。
顾平却浑然未觉，只专注地引导灵力修复她受损的经脉，甚至未曾低头看她一眼。
一旁的苏媚侧卧在地，腰间的伤口狰狞可怖。
顾平小心地撕开她腰侧的衣料，露出大片细腻的肌肤。
他的指尖把疗伤丹捻成药粉，轻轻按在伤口上，苏媚疼得弓起身子，唇间溢出一声轻喘，发丝散乱地黏在颈侧，衬得肌肤如玉。
“忍一忍。”
顾平声音沉稳，手下动作利落。
他的指尖偶尔擦过她腰窝的敏感处，苏媚咬唇别过脸去，耳尖通红。
却见顾平神色肃然，连呼吸都未曾乱一分。
楚玉支起身子，目光幽幽地落在顾平专注的侧脸上。
她伸手想替他擦去额角的血渍，却被他下意识偏头避开。
“你先疗伤。”

他简短开口，又去检查苏媚的脉象，全然未察觉两女交错的灼热视线。
为了及时处理伤口，楚玉的罗衫滑落肩头，苏媚的衣带亦松松散开。
而顾平始终脊背挺直，眼中只有疗愈的的想法，没有一点杂念。
这也让苏媚内心触动。
把两人伤势简单处理了之后，顾平就盘坐下来，立即休养。
稍一查看，他发现储物袋里已经有17具尸体。
这样的战果，对于他们三人来说简直有些天方夜谭了。
但事实是，顾平做到了，这里边还有他手刃的三位筑基修士。
远处。
赵清寒，听到这里的动静消失了，不免有些心急。
自己没有速战速决。
三位同门恐怕已经陨落。
她的攻势越发凌厉，但是她身上的伤也越来越多。
赵清寒眸光一凝，察觉到黑袍金丹的气息正在疯狂攀升。
炼血大阵的红光如潮水般向他汇聚。
content_en:
Gu Ping dragged his scarred body and staggered to his knees beside Su Mei and Chu Yu.
Their clothes were already soaked with blood and sweat, and their snow-white skin was exposed under the torn cloth. There was a hint of fragile beauty in the mess.
"I'm offended."
Gu Ping's voice was hoarse and his eyes were as clear as an ancient well.
He first helped Chu Yu up and placed his palm on the wound on her back. The yin and yang energy flowed and the gentle spiritual power penetrated into her body.
Chu Yu groaned, her body trembled unconsciously, and a blush appeared on her pale cheeks due to blood loss.
She half-closed her eyes, her eyelashes were slightly moist, and her breathing gradually became faster with the warmth of Gu Ping's palm.
"Fellow Daoist Gu..."
She murmured, her fingertips unconsciously clenching the hem of his clothes, but her body leaned softly into his arms.
Gu Ping was completely unaware of it, he only concentrated on channeling his spiritual power to repair her damaged meridians, and did not even lower his head to look at her.
Su Mei was lying on her side on the ground, with a horrific wound on her waist.
Gu Ping carefully tore open the fabric at her waist, revealing a large area of ​​delicate skin.
He twisted the healing pill into medicinal powder with his fingertips and pressed it gently on the wound. Su Mei arched her body in pain, a soft gasp escaped from her lips, her hair was messy and stuck to the side of her neck, making her skin look like jade.
"Be patient."
Gu Ping's voice was calm and his movements were swift.
His fingertips occasionally brushed against the sensitive area of ​​her waist. Su Mei bit her lip and turned away, her ears turning red.
But he saw Gu Ping's expression was solemn, and his breathing was not disturbed.
Chu Yu stood up and cast a faint gaze on Gu Ping's focused profile.
She reached out to wipe the blood from his forehead, but he subconsciously turned his head to avoid it.
"You heal first."
He spoke briefly and then went to check Su Mei's pulse, completely unaware of the burning gazes of the two women.
In order to deal with the wound in time, Chu Yu's Luo shirt slipped off his shoulders, and Su Mei's belt was also loosened.
But Gu Ping always kept his back straight, with only healing thoughts in his eyes without any distracting thoughts.
This also touched Su Mei's heart.
After simply treating their injuries, Gu Ping sat down cross-legged and immediately recuperated.
After a moment's inspection, he found that there were already 17 corpses in the storage bag.
Such a result was simply a fantasy for the three of them.
But the fact is that Gu Ping did it, and there are three foundation-building monks who are under his command.
far away.
Zhao Qinghan couldn't help but feel anxious when he heard that the movement here had disappeared.
I didn’t have a quick fix.
The three fellow disciples may have perished.
Her attacks became more and more fierce, but she also suffered more and more injuries.
Zhao Qinghan's eyes narrowed and he noticed that the aura of the black-robed golden elixir was rising crazily.
The red light from the blood refining formation gathered towards him like a tide.
